# TheExpressLanetoIntelligentCollaborationwithMicrosoftTeamsRooms

![People in a hybrid meeting room with LG display and Jabra PanaCast video bar](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Accordion-Express-Install-Jabra-PanaCast-50-VBS-1.jpg)

Microsoft Teams Rooms Express Install helps organizations bring the [Microsoft Teams](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams/) experience to more meeting spaces without the requirements of a traditional room build. Using a standardized deployment approach, teams can expand room technology without major infrastructure changes.

Drawing from Microsoft’s own deployment experience, Sarika Kesavan shares how Microsoft approaches room technology around the world. You’ll hear how Microsoft is bringing collaboration technology to more spaces without reinventing the deployment process each time.

### [Shop Express Install options now.](https://avispl.com/microsoft-teams-rooms-express-install/)

## **Watch the Podcast**

## **Inside the webcast**

- Reduce deployment complexity when expanding Microsoft Teams Rooms

- Standardized designs help create a more consistent user experience

- See how meeting spaces can benefit from built-in AI capabilities

- Learn how analytics provide greater visibility into room performance and usage

- Explore ways to make better use of existing technology investments

## **Featuring**

- **Host:** Nancy Lussier, Marketing Director, AVI-SPL

- **Guest:** Sarika Kesavan, Devices Partner Engineering, Microsoft Teams

## **Bring Microsoft Teams Rooms to more spaces**

AVI-SPL helps organizations deploy and support Microsoft Teams environments across meeting spaces of all sizes. Whether you’re refreshing existing rooms or planning additional deployments, [contact AVI-SPL](https://avispl.com/contact-us/) to continue the conversation.

### Connect with AVI-SPL

Have questions after watching? [Contact AVI-SPL](https://avispl.com/contact-us/)? Our experts are here to help.
